title: intent upgrade reports a whiteboard still on disk in a project that has none
body:
`sync.rs:201-213` prints the static NOT_YET_BUILT list from `sync.rs:168` without checking whether the project has a whiteboard at all. Line numbers as at the audit. (dc)

Found by hv's estate-wide doc audit of 2026-09-11 (the audit's orders are in `intent/history/20260911-doc-audit.md`), where it is described as built. Carried in `intent/wip.md` as an unruled defect until 2026-09-13, when that file was leaned and every open defect became an issue. Not worked until hv rules it; a ruled one gets a lane.

CLOSED 2026-09-14 17:44Z: The whiteboard leaves sync::NOT_YET_BUILT, which is now empty by delivery, so upgrade prints no not-yet-carried summary line, in a project with a whiteboard or without one. The mechanism stays (vc, ruled 2026-09-14): a class the model covers before a build carries it becomes a member, and every reader of the set already says nothing for an empty one. Fixed in the commit that closes this issue, with 0363.
